Tara: quick async check-in for SDKs / quickstarts / sample apps

Tara: what I did — pushed the macOS wheels fix, updated quickstart README with native deps notes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/compare/quickstart-macos-wheels
Tara: blocker — sampleapp ci still failing on mac runners, need help reproducing locally

Sam: did a quick run of the sample app locally, saw the same failing test on M1 runner
Sam: failing output: ```bash
pytest tests/sample_app/test_cli.py::test_build -q
E   AssertionError: expected exit code 0, got 1
```
Sam: looks like `libomp` missing in the runner image, worth trying `brew install libomp` before build

Alex: thanks — I can reproduce on my laptop, will try adding `brew install libomp` to the test matrix setup and see if it fixes CI
Alex: what I did — updated SDK docs for token caching, small nits fixed in quickstarts

Maria: FYI I left a review on Tara's PR with one doc phrasing nit and a code suggestion for the install section
Maria: quick question — should the quickstart CLI example use `RI_API_KEY` env var or read from `~/.ri/credentials` by default?

John: I'd prefer the env var in examples, keeps CI predictable. mention both in docs and show preference order in a tiny snippet
John: snippet suggestion: ```bash
# prefer env, fallback to credentials file
RI_API_KEY=xxxx make demo-run
```

Tara: good call, I'll add that and include an example credentials file section. thanks @John

Nate: ping on the sampleapp PR — I can pair to fix the install script if someone is free in the next 30m
Nate: also re: packaging, we should add a note about Apple silicon wheel availability vs. universal2 builds

Sam: +1 to pairing, can join in 15m. @Tara do you want me to run the mac image locally and attach logs?

Tara: yes please, Sam — logs would help. If you get the error above, paste the failing snippet and the `uname -a` output

Alex: I'll open a follow-up PR to add automated smoke test that runs `make demo-run` on mac runners (flaky guardrails only)

Maria: CI flakiness note — added an issue in the tracker: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/412 to track Mac runner flaps

Tara: today — I'll merge the README fixes, add env var snippet, and pair with Nate to sort the CI job. tagging @Sam and @Alex for logs.
